symptom: `check` passed a view entity whose OQL said `e.Leg != empty` or joined to an unquoted `Module.Order`; mxbuild then failed the build with CE0174 ("Cannot resolve path part 'empty'" / "The 'Order' part is incomplete or incorrect")
cause: No rule looked for `empty`, which is microflow/XPath only: OQL reads it as a path. MDL032's reserved-word list held only the date parts; its comment left the SQL keywords out as never being model names, but Order, Key and Count are common ones
insight: Measure the reserved list instead of reasoning about which words are 'plausible'. One mxbuild run with each candidate as an unquoted entity and attribute name, with known-safe names in the same run as controls, settled it: 18 SQL keywords fail (Order, Group, Limit, Offset, End, Key, Count, Sum, Distinct, Select, Like, Asc, Desc, Having, Where, Join, Exists, Cast) and Status, Value, Date, Position, Index, Coalesce, Top build. Type names (DECIMAL, STRING) must stay off the list because MDL032 matches after `as`, which is where cast() puts them. MDL071 (create-time) deliberately keeps to the date parts: warning on every Order entity at create time would be noise. An existing well-formed fixture used `Sales.Order` unquoted, which mxbuild rejects; a fixture that the platform refuses is not a control
